morning4_start.name: {name}
morning4_start.text: *Day four. Weekend. — Today isn't school. It's a date.*

minsu_cheer_1.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_1.text: *I check my phone. Morning message. — Minsu's at the top.*

minsu_cheer_4.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4.text: *Short. But 'go get 'em' hits different. The same guy who asked 'were you like this at your old school?' on Day 2, who said 'saying no is also love' on Day 3 — today it's 'go get 'em.'*

morning4_start_2.name: {name}
morning4_start_2.text: *I take a deep breath and check the messages again.*

morning4_seo_msg_1.name: Seoyeon
morning4_seo_msg_1.text: Don't be late. Park fountain, 10 o'clock.

morning4_yuna_msg_1.name: Yuna
morning4_yuna_msg_1.text: 10 o'clock. Cafe in front of the station. If you're late, I'm leaving.

morning4_dain_msg_1.name: Dain
morning4_dain_msg_1.text: Today's the day!!!! In front of the gym at 6 PM!! I'm kinda nervous lol, wait should I even be sending this

morning4_end.name: {name}
morning4_end.text: *One more glance in the mirror. — Good enough. Let's go.*

morning4_hidden_check.name: {name}
morning4_hidden_check.text: *Weekend. I end up passing by the school.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1.text: *The school gate is slightly ajar. Signs of life inside. — Someone walks out. It's the homeroom teacher. In casual clothes.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3.text: Ma'am? What are you doing here on a weekend?

hidden_homeroom_d4_4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_4.text: *The homeroom teacher in casual clothes doesn't look like a teacher. Just — like someone who writes.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_4_ins3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_4_ins3.text: You're the first student to peek through the school gate while 'just passing by.'

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_ins2.text: Let's call it an extension of educational concern. *muttering quietly* A cup of coffee should be fine, right? — Well, you're a student, so juice.

hidden_homeroom_d4_5_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_5_ins3.text: *Here we go again. The pattern of saying 'educational concern' and immediately crossing the line.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_choice.name: {name}
choices: Sure. Is there a cafe nearby?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1.text: First time having tea with a student outside school. Honestly? A bit awkward.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2.text: ...A little. After you saw it yesterday — somehow I could write more.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_3.text: Finding the first reader. Without someone to read it — the story never gets finished.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice.text: *I set down my coffee cup. Her eyes are sparkling.*
choices: Being your first reader... that's a lot of pressure

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_a.text: ...You'll know when you read it. Here's a hint — she's a bit like me.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_choice_b.text: *chuckles* If it feels heavy, you don't have to read it. — But read it with a light heart. I'd prefer that.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6.text: ...Thanks. But don't tell anyone about this — you know? ...This is our secret.

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline.text: ...Right. I shouldn't. Go on, it's the weekend, don't hang around school. — Go have fun.

hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.text: *Talking with the homeroom teacher at a cafe.*
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.context: Day 4. Ran into the teacher on the weekend, went to a cafe. She asked you to be her first reader. Tone: Conversation has gotten serious. Date excitement and nervousness. More sincerity than jokes. Moments of emotional honesty.
hidden_homeroom_d4_freetalk.personality: The teacher is more relaxed in casual clothes. Torn between passion for writing and feelings for a student.

hidden_nurse_d4_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_1.text: *The school nurse posted 'looking for helpers' on the school messenger. My feet are already heading to school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2.text: Huh? You actually came? Didn't expect that. — A student volunteering at the nurse's office on a weekend.

hidden_nurse_d4_4.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4.text: ...At the hospital I used to do all this alone. Night shifts — sometimes one nurse doing three nurses' work.

hidden_nurse_d4_5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_5.text: *Looking out the window* That's why I came here. A place where they call me 'teacher,' not 'school nurse.' — It's a small difference, but it meant a lot.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice.text: *Her name. I've been calling her School Nurse this whole time too.*
choices: So that's why you came to this school

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_a.text: *She closes her mouth for a moment.* ...Juwon. Lee Juwon.

hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_name_choice_b.text: ...Yeah. Here, everyone just comes with minor injuries. I like that.

hidden_nurse_d4_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_6.text: Thanks. I finished much faster because of you. ...That's no small thing.

hidden_nurse_d4_choice.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_choice.text: So, what should I get you as thanks? A teacher buying a student a meal totally counts as an educational activity.
choices: That's okay, I should get going

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_walk.text: *We headed to the snack shop in front of school.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1.text: Wow, that's spicy. Guess I'm too old for this stuff now.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3.text: ...That kind of thing. Sounds strange coming from a student.

hidden_nurse_d4_pass.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_pass.text: Alright. Get home safe. And come by again sometime.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_1.text: *Sunday morning. I head to the nurse's office out of habit. — When did this become a habit?*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_2.text: *I open the nurse's office door. The school nurse is sitting in her chair. White coat on. — But something's different from usual. There's no playfulness.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_4.text: *Her 'you came' is half a tone lower than usual. — I've learned to read this person's emotions through tone of voice.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_5.text: Is this the last counseling session?

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_6.text: Counseling... *she spins in her chair* Yeah. The last session.

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_7.text: *The school nurse pretends to organize paperwork on her desk — but she's turning the same piece of paper over for the third time.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_10.text: *The school nurse touches her glasses. The eyes visible through them are bigger than I expected. Eyes that were hidden behind the playfulness.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_choice.text: *It's not a question. — It's the face of someone already fearing the answer. Our eyes meet. Her serious expression with all the usual playfulness gone. — I've never seen this person so defenseless before.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_13.text: *'Really.' — Today I heard it first. Through her glasses, the nurse's eyes look wet. The playfulness returns. — But below her smiling eyes, there's a trace of something that flowed. It hurts.*

hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.text: *Talking with the school nurse in the nurse's office.*
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.context: Day 4. The moment of farewell when asking if she'll come back after graduation. The scene where both show their true hearts. Tone: Deeper, more emotional conversation. Truth behind the playfulness. The meaning of being called by name.
hidden_nurse_d4_morning_freetalk.personality: The school nurse is careful and honest. She wants to call out your name but is in a cautious position. Tears come at your promise.

hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.text: *Chatting with the nurse in the nurse's office.*
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.context: Day 4. Weekend. Helped with health checkup prep, had a meal at a snack shop, and returned to the nurse's office to talk. Talking about university hospital burnout. Tone: Conversation has become serious. Excitement and tension of a date. More sincerity than jokes. Moments where emotions become honest.
hidden_nurse_d4_freetalk.personality: The nurse in casual clothes feels like an older sister. Playfulness and sincerity alternate, and she understands the weight of being called by name.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1b.text: *We headed back to the nurse's office.*

minsu_cheer_4_ins.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_ins.text: *From warnings to confrontation, from confrontation to cheering me on. Minsu believed in me before I believed in myself.*

minsu_cheer_4_ins2.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_ins2.text: *I check my phone calendar. Seoyeon in the morning, Yuna in the afternoon, Dain in the evening. I didn't sleep last night trying to fit all three into one day. If even one schedule overlaps, it's over.*

minsu_cheer_4_ins4.name: {name}
minsu_cheer_4_ins4.text: *I checked the mirror three times. Changed clothes twice. What am I doing.*

minsu_cheer_1_ins3.name: Minsu
minsu_cheer_1_ins3.text: *Dain posted in the group chat lol Got plans tomorrow!! she said*

morning4_dain_msg_1_ins.name: {name}
morning4_dain_msg_1_ins.text: *Short and simple. But go get 'em hits hard. The same guy who asked Were you like this at your old school too? on Day 2, who said Rejection is also love on Day 3 — today it's just go get 'em.*

morning4_dain_msg_1_ins2.name: {name}
morning4_dain_msg_1_ins2.text: *From warnings to confrontation, from confrontation to cheering me on. Minsu believed in me before I believed in myself.*

morning4_seo_msg_1_ins.name: {name}
morning4_seo_msg_1_ins.text: *It's a command. She even makes date plans sound like orders. But somehow it's funny.*

morning4_seo_msg_1_ins2.name: {name}
morning4_seo_msg_1_ins2.text: *I'm standing at the meeting spot. Will she come? After how angry she was on Friday.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1_ins.text: *She's coming. I can see her from a distance. Hard to believe this is the same person who was so angry — walking so casually.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_1_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_1_ins2.text: *She must have been angry — but she still came out. I can't run away in front of this person.*

morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins.text: *Short. So Yuna. I now know that I'll leave if you're late means the same as please don't be late.*

morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins3.name: Dain
morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins3.text: *If you're late I'll seriously be mad!!*

morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins4.name: Dain
morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins4.text: *Ahh why am I so nervous lol should I even send this*

morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins5.name: {name}
morning4_yuna_msg_1_ins5.text: *She probably didn't mean to send that last line. But it's Dain, so of course she did.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins.text: *Flustered* Oh, it's just — I had some paperwork left.

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins2.text: *Paperwork. She was probably working on her manuscript in an empty classroom. I know that now.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_3_ins4.text: *Hands in pockets* ...A teacher's still a teacher on weekends. You know how it is.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins2.text: *Taking a sip of coffee* Honestly? A little.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins3.text: *Honest. This person hides behind dry humor, but sometimes a candid moment slips through.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins4.text: Did you write more of the manuscript yesterday?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_1_ins5.text: *She sets down her coffee cup. Pauses, as if thinking.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins.text: Did me seeing it actually help?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins2.text: More than help... *Looking out the window* Having someone find out was — a relief. Carrying something alone isn't a secret, it's a burden.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins3.text: *A burden. So the unfinished manuscript she carried alone for seven years was weighing on her.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_2_ins4.text: Do you know what the hardest part of writing a novel is?

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_6_ins.text: *She's looking at me. Eyes that aren't dry.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_4_ins.text: *Déjà vu. She said something similar in the empty classroom yesterday. But today, in a café and dressed casually, it sounds lighter. No — more serious.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins.text: *She smiles briefly. Not an awkward smile — a smile of relief.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins2.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins2.text: ...Thank you. But this stays between us, okay? ...This is our secret. A teacher shouldn't have secrets with a student, though.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins4.name: Homeroom Teacher
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins4.text: *Freezes* ...Don't steal my line before I say it.

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins5.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins5.text: *I chuckled. She chuckled too. At the same time.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins7.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_cafe_5_ins7.text: *She takes her hands out of her pockets. A motion like adjusting her cardigan — oh, she's in casual clothes. An empty gesture.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_ins.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_ins.text: *She turns away. Her shoulders droop slightly.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_decline_ins2.text: *I turned her down, so why does my chest feel like this. I walked back home.*

hidden_nurse_d4_1_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_1_ins.text: *The nurse's office. Papers and checkup equipment piled on the desk. The School Nurse is sorting things in casual clothes. A beige knit instead of the white coat.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins.text: So the patient is helping the nurse.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins2.text: *Laughing* First time a patient ever helped the nurse.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins3.text: *Her laugh is natural. Different from how she is at school. Out of the white coat, the School Nurse isn't a teacher — she's more like an older sister.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins4.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins4.text: *I help sort the checkup documents. Sorting name tags, organizing eye chart sheets, sterilizing blood pressure monitors.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins5.text: *Handing over documents* Can you sort these? By grade.

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins6.text: *We sit side by side sorting papers. Every time our hands brush, the School Nurse pulls hers back slightly. Is she aware of it.*

hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_2_ins7.text: ...At the university hospital, I used to do all this by myself.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins2.text: *The School Nurse pauses. Sets down the papers.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins3.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins3.text: ...The hardest part back then wasn't the workload.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins5.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins5.text: *Voice dropping half a tone* Nobody called me by my name. 'Nurse,' 'night shift,' 'Ward 3.' All titles, never my name.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins6.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins6.text: *The playfulness is completely gone. This is how her real feelings show.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins7.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins7.text: At school I'm 'School Nurse,' right? Another title. *With a slight smile* But you — you've never once called me by a title, have you?

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins9.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins9.text: You just call me 'teacher' — not 'school nurse.' I liked that.

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins10.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins10.text: *She knows the weight of being called by name. Because she was called by numbers at the hospital.*

hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins11.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_4_ins11.text: *The sorting is done. The School Nurse stretches.*

hidden_nurse_d4_6_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_6_ins3.text: *Two short words, but they carry weight.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_ins.text: You must've had this when you were a student too.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_ins2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_1_ins2.text: That was ages ago. *laughs* I'm old now.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_2_ins.text: *The School Nurse pauses. Sets down her chopsticks.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins.text: *The playfulness vanished. — Seeing this expression makes my chest tighten.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins2.name: School Nurse
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins2.text: *Smiling again* Alright, lunch break's over. I've still got work to do.

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins3.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_3_ins3.text: *On the way back. The School Nurse calls from behind.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_ins.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_ins.text: *She added really. When this person adds really, it means everything before it was sincere.*

hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_ins2.name: {name}
hidden_nurse_d4_meal_4_ins2.text: *She snapped back, but her ears are red. Again.*

hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.name: {name}
hidden_homeroom_d4_skip.text: *My steps stop for a moment, and then I keep walking past.*
